comparison.objective: Replace a cartridge in a ratchet-rod dispenser and restore the tool to working configuration; candidate sifts media from retained workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Pawl disengagement, rod retraction, cartridge removal/insertion and re-engagement versus bimanual screen manipulation and size-selective passage of loose bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Used cartridge collected, replacement aligned and seated, piston/rod/pawl restored, tool cradled and hands released versus media recovery and washer retention with spill/damage gates and 3-second dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests multi-stage mechanism servicing and insertion, not dynamic separation through apertures.
